newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-SMITH BARNEY UPS CHASE TARGET.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-SMITH BARNEY UPS CHASE TARGET.

text.p: Smith Barney has increased its share price target for Chase Manhattan Corp to $140 from $125 after running its cash flow forecast models following the bank's second quarter earnings, said a Smith Barney analyst who declined to be named.
-- In a telephone interview, the Smith Barney analyst said Chase should also benefit from an improved investor perceptions that the outlook for credit card bad debts had improved.
-- He noted that Chase was the cheapest of the 45 banks followed by Smith Barney on 1997 and 1998 earnings per share forecasts.
